review.why: Wraps up finished work: run the full tests, detect the git setup, present three integration options and clean up only what it created.
review.summary: Verifies the full test suite first and stops on failures. It detects whether it is in a normal repo, a named-branch worktree or a detached HEAD, confirms the base branch, then presents a fixed menu: merge locally, push and open a pull request, or keep as is. Discarding work only happens on explicit request. Cleanup of a worktree depends on who created it.
strengths: Tests must pass before any option is offered
Confirms the base branch before merging
Fixed menu and no discard unless explicitly asked
cautions: Assumes git and a project test command
Later steps for pull requests and cleanup were not read in full
Merge and push choices change shared history
